name: dumbbell elevated heel front squat
description: A front squat with a dumbbell and raised heels, which keeps your torso upright and puts the work on the quads.
instructions: Place your heels on small plates and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Brace your core and keep your elbows up.
Sit down into a deep squat.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over toes.
